headline: On October 22, 2001: Microsoft releases Windows XP
captionCards: XP's design influences modern OS today
instagramCaption:
Microsoft launches one of its most successful OS, Windows XP.\nOn October 25, 2001, Microsoft Corporation, headquartered in Redmond, Washington, released Windows XP. This operating system became a cornerstone in the rise of personal computers. Surprisingly, it was so popular that support for it continued until 2014. Today, Windows XP's legacy is still felt in the design and functionality of modern operating systems. What do you remember about using Windows XP? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳]
